_about: WORDS TWO, HIS HOMEWORK, THE FIRST TWENTY (VAMILY rule 454(c), ask row 629). One card, one line, exactly as the game's data holds it today. Each card is picked to teach something no other card teaches (teaches). tools/bohemia_words_two_homework.js reads the line out of the named file; nothing here is a line. No rewrite of ours rides on any card.

cards.who_plain: A hungry kid on the road
cards.when: he stops your crew and begs for food
cards.where: on the MAP, on the card that stops your crew on the road
cards.teaches: BEGGING, from a kid, in short broken sentences with a Spanish opener: how a desperate person asks, and how much Spanish is right

cards.role: leads the crew across from you
cards.who_plain: The leader of the House's men
cards.when: a fight starts, to say why they are on you
cards.where: on the card that opens a FIGHT
cards.teaches: THE WHY LINE: one sentence from an enemy saying why he is about to kill you; 127 of these share one shape (this, and that)

cards.who_plain: A regular person in the valley
cards.when: it is a quiet day and they post a joke
cards.where: on the phone's FEED
cards.teaches: A TWEET that is a joke: meme talk, lower case, from somebody with nothing

cards.mouth: A JOB GIVER AT THE BOARD
cards.who_plain: An old woman at the job board
cards.when: you ask what her job is and what it pays
cards.where: in a camp or TOWN, at the board where people offer jobs
cards.teaches: A JOB OFFER: somebody poor asking armed men for help and naming the pay herself, in two sentences

cards.who_plain: Your man who only thinks about money
cards.when: his shot hits a man
cards.where: in the FIGHT, over his head
cards.teaches: A ONE-WORD BARK in the middle of a fight: the shortest thing anybody says, and it is a joke

cards.who_plain: A cartel man at a checkpoint
cards.when: two trucks block the road and he wants a tenth of your cart
cards.where: on the MAP, on the card that stops your crew on the road
cards.teaches: A THREAT from somebody who has the power and is relaxed about it: how a shake-down sounds

cards.role: the one the whole town answers to
cards.who_plain: The Elder of a town
cards.when: you walk into a town
cards.where: in a TOWN, under the town's name as you arrive
cards.teaches: A WELCOME with a warning inside it, one sentence, from the town's top man: the first words every town says

cards.who_plain: Your driest man, still standing
cards.when: you win a fight, in the spot where YOU WON used to be
cards.where: on the screen after a FIGHT
cards.teaches: MORBID FUNNY, your 11/2 ask ('like real killers'): is this the joke you meant

cards.who_plain: A man looking for work
cards.when: you look him over at the hiring post before you pay him
cards.where: in a TOWN, at the hall where you hire men
cards.teaches: A PITCH: a dangerous man selling himself in three short sentences, with his past in it

cards.who_plain: The guard at a town's gate
cards.when: the lookout stops answering, while a town you hold falls and nobody came to help
cards.where: on the phone's FEED, while the town falls
cards.teaches: FEAR over the radio, three words: you called this kind of communication your swag on 11/3, so this card checks our line against that

cards.who_plain: One of your own men
cards.when: he admits at the night stop that he took six batteries
cards.where: on the MAP, on a card at the night stop
cards.teaches: A CONFESSION from one of HIS men to HIM: how his own crew talks to the boss when it is serious

cards.role: keeper of the last good pot
cards.who_plain: The boss called THE POT
cards.when: you walk into his place to fight him
cards.where: on the card that opens his FIGHT
cards.teaches: A BOSS: the biggest mouth in the game gets the same kind of line as a road thug today; how should the top dog talk

cards.who_plain: A timeshare salesman outside a dead resort
cards.when: you walk past and he tries to sell you a vacation
cards.where: on the MAP, on the card that stops your crew on the road
cards.teaches: A JOKE card, the longest kind (four sentences): how funny sounds in this world, and how long a card may run

cards.role: buys and sells food, meds and gear
cards.who_plain: The keeper of the stall
cards.when: you open the shop to buy and sell
cards.where: in a TOWN, at the stall
cards.teaches: HAGGLING, or refusing to: how somebody who sells for a living talks about money

cards.who_plain: One of your crew
cards.when: DESI gets shot down in front of them
cards.where: in the FIGHT, over the speaker's head
cards.teaches: PANIC AND LOVE in four words when a friend drops: the most emotional second of a fight

cards.who_plain: A priest ringing a bell at night
cards.when: you find him at a crossroads in the dark
cards.where: on the MAP, on the card that stops your crew on the road
cards.teaches: GRIEF said out loud by an old man: how sad sounds without turning into a poem

cards.role: tells you what was heard, after a round
cards.who_plain: The one behind the bar
cards.when: you buy a round and ask what is going on
cards.where: in a TOWN, at the bar
cards.teaches: GOSSIP: a second-hand story with doubt in it, the way news travels with no phones

cards.who_plain: A woman in Houston
cards.when: it is a quiet day and she posts about home
cards.where: on the phone's FEED
cards.teaches: A SAD TWEET from far away: three plain sentences that are supposed to hurt; you said the far posts read like 'what does that even mean'

cards.role: THE COOK, would travel with your crew
cards.who_plain: A cook who would travel with your crew
cards.when: you meet her at the hall and she says why you should take her
cards.where: in a TOWN at the hall, and at your camp fire once she is with you
cards.teaches: BRAGGING: an older woman who is good at her job and knows it, talking down to the boss a little

cards.role: a person in the crowd, no name until you ask
cards.who_plain: A stranger standing in the street
cards.when: you tap a random person in a town
cards.where: in a TOWN, over a person in the crowd
cards.teaches: A NOBODY: what a regular person on a corner says to an armed stranger, two short sentences

_order: The tab shows twelve cards before its MORE fold (records/target/BOHEMIA_VOTE_TRIAGE.json cap), so cards 1 to 12 carry every kind of mouth he named (the road, the town, his men in a fight, the enemy, a boss, a hire, the feed) and 13 to 20 are the second look at each.
